files.description: The rules for any agent or contributor changing this repository: what is where, the commands CI runs, the kit release and copy rules, the community defaults' contracts, and the organization rules. Review findings cite these rules.

What the repository holds, path by path, and the media metadata rules (profile kleidos-media-meta/1, the stamp and the checker, the privacy deny-list) and the license split. Review findings cite these rules.

The organization-wide contributing guide: English only, imperative commit messages, one concern per pull request, documentation in the same change, no bypassed checks, SPDX headers, and the board-support and donation rules. Review findings cite these rules.
